citations.title: PJM, 2020–2024 Weighted Average EFORd by Fuel Type (Class Average Values effective 1 June 2025)
citations.parameter: FOR = PJM Fossil-Steam WEFORd 15.100 % (proxy: steam-cycle plants; likely conservative)

notes: Expected hourly availability = (1-FOR)*(1-planned share)*(1-ambient derate); FOR=0.151, planned outage 21 d/yr. Proxy statistics from the fossil steam fleet; planned outage days/yr (summer overhaul) is a modelling assumption. Fuel seasonality not modelled.
